name: BlogPostBody - Locked, Prompt Replaces The Article
description: The locked branch, and the one worth guarding. The entry's body is real ciphertext and the slot holds ordinary markdown; a correct render shows neither, because the unlock prompt replaces the article entirely. The first attempt at this feature rendered the ciphertext as a paragraph — a wall of base64 where the writing should be — which is exactly what this frame exists to catch if it ever returns.
